products.product_description:
2/24 ounce clear plastic bags of 3/8 inch diced Roma tomatoes. These bags are in a cardboard carton. The bags and carton have a yellow label that reads in part:
Boskovich Farms, Inc Costco Deli Dept. 63 ***QUINOA SALAD KIT Item # 624843 CONTENTS: (2) QUINIA MIX *** (2) Diced Roma *** NET WT: 23.96 LBS
.
products.reason_for_recall: Boskovich Farms is recalling Roma Tomatoes because they may be contaminated with Salmonella.
